theme: An open Sunday before the season turns
greeting: A wide-open Sunday in St. Pete with the girls, Dan — just the 15-minute review with Mike this morning and nothing fixed since. It's the clearest runway you'll get before the travel weeks start.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night
needsAttention.detail: On the trip board since Aug 26 and still open — the charter ends at ACI Komolac around noon Sept 19 and you need a Cavtat room plus a transfer. It has to be booked from dry land before you fly out Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Croatia checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since Aug 25 — the issued ticket shows zero checked bags on Eurowings Discover. Verify the allowance on the operating carrier's site and buy bags online before counter rates hit.

needsAttention.title: Close the Sept 20–22 St Pete gap
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since Aug 25 — you land TPA Sept 20 but the girls aren't picked up until Sept 22, so two nights near St Pete are still unbooked.

needsAttention.title: Nautilus Sailing invoice unpaid
needsAttention.detail: QuickBooks flagged invoice 2170 for $6,475 as unfinished — it's the Croatia course balance, worth clearing before the Sept 12 start.

flagged.title: Croatia crew intros are rolling in
flagged.detail: Instructor Paul and the two other sailors have introduced themselves ahead of the Sept 12 course; you haven't chimed in yet.

flagged.title: Caregiver applicants waiting on Care.com
flagged.detail: A handful of new applications to your posted job over the past two days.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters — WSJ, NYT Cooking, a Dex digest, a Substack receipt.

recipe.title: Canal house year-round caprese salad
recipe.why: High-summer tomatoes and basil are at their peak right now, so a no-cook plate lets the season carry it.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters + US power strip

acts.line: A single 15-minute Sunday review with Mike, then the day opened up.
Wide open in St. Pete — the rare unbroken stretch before the travel weeks begin.
The girls are with you and Mike; tomorrow reads empty too.
